value.rationale: The diagonal noncentral pyramid is the explicit natural construction behind the strict gap between unrestricted and central maximal cube pyramids. The exact unique optimizer, dimension-four algebraic benchmark and dimension-uniform 1/6 displacement with two correction coefficients sharpen a qualitative inequality into a computable constructive bound. The work does not claim global directional optimality, and the Fourier analysis is substantive beyond simply rewriting the known derivative.
